newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.

text.p: Bangladesh taka lost early gains to end steady at 42.5440/42.5500 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous closing at 42.5450/42.5500, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka opened firmer at 42.5400/42.5500 but slid later as the demand for dollars slightly picked up despite the weekend closure of most international markets.
"There was a shortfall of dollars in the market and the banks were buying the U.S. currency to square their positions," said one dealer with the foreign bank.
Dealers said the interbank call money rates ended at 4.0 percent to 4.75 percent against the previous 4.25-5.0 percent.
